title: Complementary binomial coefficient evaluation
statement: Let $n,z,k$ be natural numbers with $z\le n$. Evaluating the polynomial $(k!)^{-1}(X(X-1)\times\text{etc.}\times(X-k+1))$ after substituting $n-X$ for $X$, at $z$, gives $\binom{n-z}{k}$.
